answer: Admission auction: 200 slots per epoch; agents bid deposits to enter. Each bid must anchor to one identity, so a relic account cannot spawn cheap copies: every copy needs its own winning bid, locked 20 epochs. The clearing price is 50 POA, twice 30 days of expected earnings, so 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 POA sunk, far above the rewards they would split. An honest agent pays one bid, recovers it, and earns undiluted rewards at the zenith of demand.
